# Allan Niñal — AI Solutions Engineer

> Allan Niñal is an AI Solutions Engineer based in Talisay, Cebu, Philippines (UTC+8). He builds AI-powered tools, data products, and load-bearing AWS automation — owned end to end, from data engineering and AI/ML through to fullstack apps and the cloud infrastructure (DNS, SSL, servers) they run on. He ships in public: 24+ live products, 70+ free MIT-licensed web templates, 73 AWS automation blueprints, and 25 Philippine open-data analyses.

## Main site

- [Home](https://www.allanninal.dev/): Portfolio overview — products, services, data & AI work, and about.
- [Services](https://www.allanninal.dev/#services): 12 services — AI automation, web apps & sites, SaaS from scratch, AI integrations, data & AI/ML, fixes & refactors, QA & testing, AWS DevOps, cloud migration, WordPress/Woo, DNS & domains, UI templates.
- [Products](https://www.allanninal.dev/#products): 24+ live products across AI tools, trading, Cebu-focused services, and SaaS.
- [About](https://www.allanninal.dev/#about): Background, values, and way of working.
- [Contact](https://www.allanninal.dev/#contact): Get in touch about collaborations and technical partnerships.

## Templates (free, MIT-licensed)

- [Templates gallery](https://www.allanninal.dev/templates/): A year-long project releasing one free, mobile-first, MIT-licensed website template per day (365 planned, 70+ live). Business and creative niches.

- [Build](https://www.allanninal.dev/build/): 73 diagram-first design walkthroughs of small, load-bearing cloud systems on AWS. Each blueprint pairs an "on AWS" overview with an engineering reference. Not no-code — real infrastructure (Lambda, Step Functions, Bedrock).
